instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: Reliability Measures and the Nature of the Models

questions.question: Failure occurrences can be represented by...
options: the time to failure here now again
the failures inside a time interval
all of the above answers too here
options_en: the time to failure here now again
the failures inside a time interval
all of the above answers too here
questions.explanation: All three views of the same data are used, depending on the model.
questions.explanation_ar: الثلاثة رؤى للبيانات نفسها تُستخدم حسب النموذج.

questions.question: What is the maximum possible value of reliability?
questions.explanation: Reliability is a probability, so one is the ceiling and zero is the floor.
questions.explanation_ar: الموثوقية احتمال، فالواحد هو السقف والصفر هو الأرضية.

questions.question: What is the minimum possible value of reliability?
questions.explanation: A system that always fails has reliability of zero.
questions.explanation_ar: النظام الذي يفشل دائماً موثوقيته صفر.

questions.question: As reliability increases, failure intensity...
questions.explanation: More failures are removed as the product matures, so the intensity falls.
questions.explanation_ar: تُزال أعطال أكثر مع نضج المنتج، فتنخفض الشدة.

questions.question: With an intensity of 0.005 failures per hour over ten hours, the probability of no failure is about...
questions.question_ar: بشدة 0.005 عطل بالساعة على عشر ساعات، احتمال عدم العطل يقارب...
questions.explanation: Over ten hours the expected count is 0.05, so survival is close to one.
questions.explanation_ar: على عشر ساعات العدد المتوقع 0.05، فالنجاة قريبة من الواحد.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a software reliability model?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس نموذج موثوقية برمجية؟
options: none of the above now again
options_ar: لا شيء مما سبق هنا أيضاً
options_en: none of the above now again
questions.explanation: The spiral model is a life-cycle model, not a reliability model.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج الحلزوني نموذج دورة حياة، لا نموذج موثوقية.

questions.question: In reliability models, the emphasis is on...
questions.explanation: The models count observed failures, not the errors that caused them.
questions.explanation_ar: النماذج تعدّ الأعطال الملاحظة، لا الأخطاء التي سبّتها.

questions.question: The basic execution time model was developed by...
questions.explanation: Musa proposed the basic and logarithmic Poisson execution time models.
questions.explanation_ar: موسى اقترح نموذجي زمن التنفيذ الأساسي واللوغاريتمي.

questions.question: NHPP stands for...
questions.explanation: The models treat failure occurrence as a non-homogeneous Poisson process.
questions.explanation_ar: النماذج تعامل حدوث الأعطال كعملية بواسون غير متجانسة.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a reliability model?
options: to replace the testing now here again too here
to predict failures from execution history
to write the program code too now here
to price the licence here again too now
options_en: to replace the testing now here again too here
to predict failures from execution history
to write the program code too now here
to price the licence here again too now
questions.explanation: The model extrapolates the failure curve so the next release can be judged.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج يستنتج منحنى الأعطال ليُقيَّم الإصدار التالي.
